en.headline: Fire Services Department deploys AI-assisted drones and extra patrols for Chung Yeung hill-fire risk
en.dek: More than 250 frontline staff will form 12 patrol teams at high-risk sites in the New Territories, with drones sending live images for real-time smoke detection.
body: The Fire Services Department said on Friday it would mobilise more than 250 frontline personnel to form 12 patrol teams at 12 higher-risk locations for hill fires in the New Territories on Saturday and Sunday ahead of the Chung Yeung Festival.

Acting Divisional Officer Wong Tak-fai said the department was introducing AI-assisted drone technology so that images from drones could be analysed in real time to identify smoke more quickly and accurately, allowing staff to prioritise responses.

The department has also prepared large drones capable of carrying water for remote drops and a remote-operated system mounted on an electric all-terrain vehicle that can support continuous drone operations for up to 48 hours without staff on site.

Officials noted that past data showed an average of about 30 hill fires in the two weeks around Chung Yeung, and that the forecast of mainly fine and dry weather later on Sunday would increase the risk as more people visit graveyards.

zh.headline: 消防處重陽節前動員逾二百五十人巡邏 引入AI無人機協助偵測山火
zh.dek: 超過250名前線人員組成12支巡邏隊進駐新界高風險地點，無人機影像實時傳送AI平台識別煙霧。
body: 消防處周五表示，因六及周日會動員超過250名前線人員組成12支巡邏隊，到新界12個山火風險較高地點巡邏，應對即將來臨的重陽節。
署理消防區長王德輝指，處方引入AI協助的無人機技術，讓無人機影像實時分析，更快速準確識別煙霧，便於優先處理。
處方亦準備可搶水的大型無人機作遠距投放，以及裝於純電動全地形車的遠距操作系統，可支援無人機連續工作最多48小時而無需人員在場。
官員指，過往數據顯示重陽節前後兩星期平均約有30宗山火，而周日天氣預報大致天晴乾燥，更多市民登山掃墓會增加風險。
